text:
Maya: FYI — Sandstone channel lead wants a joint co-sell POC. Key asks: embedded connector for their SaaS, VPC peering vs private connector, telemetry opt-in, pricing for trial, and a security checklist. Who can pick this up?
Tom: I can take the arch + connector options. Quick take: private connector inside their VPC is best for data residency; peering is possible but needs network team review. SDK can do cache-first; no model weights shipped.
Ethan: Security: require TLS1.3, option for mTLS, API keys rotated via KMS, no persisted user-level logs by default, telemetry must be opt-in for co-sell builds. Need Sandstones expected QPS and sample dataflow diagram.
Zara: Pricing: for the POC offer a 30-day Dedicated node credit + a capped number of cache-miss calls. Two pricing paths: reserved baseline or burst-only with higher per-call rates. Ill draft numbers.
Maya: Sandstone asked if they can run a local LRU cache (SQLite) and anonymize PII client-side. Also want SAML SSO flow for enterprise customers.
Tom: Architecturally fine to use local SQLite cache. SDK should expose a CacheAdapter interface. On miss, route to their private endpoint or our private connector. Recommend deterministic pseudonymization instead of hashing for better embedding quality.
Ethan: On SSO — we support SAML and OIDC; for enterprise SAML is common. We'll need SP metadata and attribute mapping. Also ask Sandstone whether they require SCIM for user provisioning.
Zara: For the quote: propose 1-month Dedicated credit + 5M token allotment + $0.22 / 1k cache-miss embeddings beyond that (placeholder). Add optional 24/7 support for commercial pilot.
Maya: Actions: Tom  draft connector options + sample SDK config; Ethan  security questionnaire + blockers; Zara  provisional pricing + SOW snippet. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with Sandstone for Wed 9am PT.
reminder-bot: Event scheduled: "Sandstone co-sell POC kickoff"  Wed 9:00 AM PT. Invite sent.
Tom: Posting a minimal SDK config example before the call:```json
{
  "endpoint": "https://private.sandstone.redwood.example",
  "auth": "api_key",
  "cache": {"type": "sqlite", "ttl_secs": 3600},
  "telemetry": {"enabled": false}
}
```
Ethan: Sending questionnaire in DM. Please review before external share.
Zara: Will include telemetry opt-in wording and trial SLA in the quote. :+1:
Maya: Cool. Also request Sandstone provide an anonymized dataset (<=500 rows) to run a quick quality check if they pseudonymize.
